name: DS-77EX

name: "A power bridge network developed exclusively for M-60, P-300S, and P-300.An operational amplifier (IC) with particularly excellent high-frequency characteristics and S/N is used for the buffer and phase inversion circuit. This eliminates the need for phase correction in a wide range and suppresses sound quality degradation.In addition to making the NF loop DC, the condenser is removed for both input and output, and the coloration is removed.There is a caveat to this bridge network.Since it is designed exclusively for M-60, P-300S and P-300, it cannot be used for other products even if it is an Accuphase product. It may generate large distortion or induce oscillation before the maximum output.The speaker impedance should be 8 � or more. If the impedance drops at a specific frequency, a point of 5 � or less may cause distortion near the maximum output.Therefore, it is recommended to check the impedance characteristics of the speaker beforehand.

"An audio programmer that can be combined with a PC to create sound and systems.Unlike conventional processors in which dedicated programs are written in the DSP in advance, the SH-D1000 is equipped with a program-rewriting DSP, which enables you to use a wide range of functions by changing and setting programs using your personal computer.Equipped with a unique S-Advanced Mash Class A D/A converter and A/D converter, it can be used not only as a program transfer from a PC, but also as a digital preamplifier using the DAC unit or analog volume of your system.One analog and digital (optical) Route 3 are mounted on the input terminals, and two analog and digital (optical) terminals are mounted on the outputs.In addition, it has a single digital recording output.Up to three sound adjustment programs created on a PC can be saved and read in the SH-D1000.BTL drive of the power amplifier is possible.Digital sampling frequency is 44.1 kHz and MD recording is possible.Wireless remote control is included.The software posted on the Technics website could be purchased on a floppy disk.
